sin.name: literal-actor-id
sin.description: An actor or an agent is made with a number written in the code as its id, so it can land in the agents' range or on an id another row holds.
sin.rule: An actor's id comes from the allocator: ActorTable.next_agent_actor_id or main_agent_actor_id for an agent, next_other_actor_id for any other actor, and the constants CORE_ACTOR_ID and MAIN_AGENT_ID for the core and the main agent.
